Hi Sophie — copying in a couple quick troubleshooting steps before we fall back to the manual invite:

1) When you open the Calendly booking page, check the timezone selector (top-right). It should show "(GMT+08:00) Singapore". If it shows something else, change it and rebook.
2) If you booked via a mobile device, the mobile calendar sometimes rewrites event times when it syncs — try re-checking on a desktop calendar client.
3) If the invite already landed, we can send an .ics with the correct TZ and a short note; that will overwrite the original event for most calendar systems.

I'll prepare a manual .ics for 2026-12-07 11:00 SGT and send it to you, Sophie, with a note that it supersedes the earlier invite.
